description:
Hear the sweet sounds of Austin's live music performances and lively streets from your very own contemporary apartment. Featuring high-rise views of downtown, your Kasa is within walking distance of local restaurants, nightlife, and most importantly; South Congress Bridge. Our tech-enabled apartments offer self-check-in at 4pm, 24/7 guest support by text, phone, or chat, and a Virtual Front Desk accessed via mobile device.

The space
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT:
- Bedroom 1: 1 king-size bed (sleeps 2)
- Bedroom 2: 1 king-size bed (sleeps 2)
- Living Room: 1 full-size sofa bed (sleeps 2)

PARKING:
- Our property offers paid parking at a rate of $30 per day. Please plan your trip accordingly, as parking options in the area are limited.

LIVING SPACE:
- Newly renovated kitchen with dishes, cookware, and dishwasher
- 2 fully renovated bathrooms
- Roku TV
- Furnished balcony with city view
- In-unit washer and dryer
- 1,187 square feet

We have multiple Kasas in this building, and each one is unique. Decor and layout can vary slightly from what you see in the photos.

Guest access
In addition to your private space, you can enjoy the building’s shared amenities.

BUILDING AMENITIES:
- Outdoor pool and sundeck
- Onsite movie theater
- Business center
- Two 24-hour health and fitness centers
- Stand-alone spin room

We manage each aspect of your stay, so you can count on reliable service from booking to checkout, all while enjoying a self-directed experience. Every Kasa offers:

- 24/7 support (text, chat, email, or call us any time!)
- A desirable locale close to points of interest and attractions
- Professional cleaning
- Thoughtful design for your comfort and convenience
- Security protocols, including ID verification
- Care-focused technology for detecting noise and smoke

Other things to note
PLEASE NOTE:
- Guests are required to complete a Pre-Arrival Checklist, which includes a virtual ID check, and the option to request early check-in (subject to availability). We operate through a Virtual Front Desk, and self check-in is entirely contactless. We'll send you instructions on accessing our property and your Kasa before you arrive. Questions? Contact us 24/7.
- One approved animal is allowed per unit at a nightly fee of $8-30/night based on length of stay. Pet registration is required prior to arrival.
- Our property offers paid parking at a rate of $30 per day. Parking fees will be collected online through your Kasa Booking Confirmation.
- Austin is growing! Construction projects in progress at, or near, this property. Though all construction abides by city noise ordinances, construction may result in additional background noise at your Kasa.
- This property does not have luggage storage.
- Daily housekeeping services are only provided upon request at an additional cost per cleaning.
- Austin is growing! Please note that there are ongoing construction projects in the vicinity of this property. While all work complies with city noise regulations, you may experience occasional background noise during your stay at Kasa.

hostDetails.about:
Hello!  Erik and I have lived in Austin for about 10 years.  I work for AISD and Erik works from home as a concept artist for a video game company out of Chicago.  We both spend a lot of time working, running and working out at the gym.  We also see a movie about once a week and like eating out on the weekends. 

I love to travel.  Last April I went to Europe for a second time and had a blast.  I would love to go back if only time would allow.  

We want to make sure anyone who stays with us has a great time.  Always feel free to give us a call for restaurant recommendations or just to say hello :)
